app.title: MopedMaps
area.error.no-tiles: No map data for this area yet.
area.error.router: The road network could not be loaded.
area.error.network: No connection. Please try again later.
route.tapStart: Tap the map to set the start.
route.tapTarget: Tap the map to set the destination.
route.error.start-off-network: Start is too far from a usable road.
route.error.target-off-network: Destination is too far from a usable road.
route.error.unreachable: No permitted route found (e.g. only via motorway or outside the radius).
profile.title: Vehicle
profile.invalidVmax: Please enter a value between {min} and {max} km/h.
info.limitations: Routes only within the loaded radius. No traffic data.
weights.title: Route preference
weights.hint: More safety avoids fast, unlit roads without cycle lanes – routes often get a bit longer.
map.offlineBasemap: Basemap unavailable offline – route and area still work.
map.offlineRoads: Offline: no map background – showing the roads of the loaded area. Tapping a destination and navigating still work.
chart.title: Elevation & speed
chart.legend: km/h (left, blue) · elevation in m (right, green) · distance in km
chart.noHeights: no elevation data in these tiles
chart.hint: Tap or hover over the chart for values.
profile.energyHint: With a capacity the route shows the range. Real consumption calibrates the energy model.
nav.noGps: Location unavailable – please allow location access.
prefs.title: Safety in detail
prefs.hint: − halves, + doubles the influence. Works together with the safety weight.
prefs.coverage: Roadwork closures are only available for Baden-Württemberg, Saxony, Brandenburg and Berlin, measured traffic volumes only for Baden-Württemberg, Bavaria, Saxony, Brandenburg, Berlin and Hamburg. Other states do not publish this data under an open licence, so for licensing reasons it is missing there; the app then estimates traffic from the road type.
search.notReady: Search available once the area is loaded
search.unavailable: Search not available yet – the search data is still being built
search.none: Nothing found in the loaded area.
places.title: Destinations
places.notSet: Not set yet – choose a destination, then tap ＋.
places.saveHint: ＋ saves the current destination as home or work.
places.goHint: Tap: route from the current start (or your location) there.
welcome.title: Welcome to MopedMaps
welcome.safety: Traffic rules and signs on site always take precedence. Do not operate the app while riding.
welcome.noWarranty: Routes, speed limits, closures and range are based on open data (OpenStreetMap and others) and may be wrong or outdated – no warranty.
welcome.privacy: No account, no tracking: settings, destinations and map data stay on your device.
welcome.ios.install: iPhone: install it via “Share → Add to Home Screen” – then it also works offline.
welcome.ios.screen: iPhone: while navigating the screen must stay on and the app in the foreground (no background GPS).
welcome.ios.voice: iPhone: turn off the silent switch for voice guidance.
welcome.android.install: Android: use “Install app” in the browser menu – then it also works offline.
welcome.android.battery: Android: keep the screen on while navigating; battery saver can slow down location updates.
welcome.desktop.plan: On a computer the app is good for planning; use your phone to navigate.
learn.purpose.learning: This is how the app learns your vehicle's real consumption; after a few rides it only asks now and then.
learn.purpose.check: A quick check to keep the range estimate up to date.
learn.battery.title: How much battery did you use?
learn.battery.skipHint: Skip if the ride was not typical: e.g. with a passenger, lots of luggage, strong wind or severe cold.
learn.error.percent: Please enter percentages from 0 to 100; the battery must have dropped by at least {n} percentage points.
learn.error.capacity: Please enter the usable battery capacity in Wh (see the data sheet, e.g. 1500).
learn.error.litres: Please enter the litres refilled as a number or leave the field empty.
learn.fuelStart.title: Learn consumption (full-tank method)
learn.fuelStart.text: Fill the tank up and tap “Tank is full”. From then on the app counts all navigated rides until the next full tank. Rides without navigation in between distort the measurement.
learn.fuelRide.title: Ride counts towards the consumption measurement
learn.fuelRide.text: Ride: {km} km, {total} km with navigation since the last full tank. Just filled up? Then enter the litres refilled, otherwise leave it empty.
learn.fuelRide.skipHint: “Don't count this ride” if it was not typical (e.g. with a passenger). The measurement then restarts at the next full tank.
learn.status.none.electric: Learn consumption: after navigated rides the app asks a few times for the battery level.
learn.status.none.combustion: Learn consumption: fill up, tap “Filled up”, ride with navigation and enter the litres at the next full tank.
learn.status.manualFirst: Until there are enough measurements, the consumption entered above is used.
learn.fuelStarted: Measuring: navigated rides count until the next full tank.
learn.fuelSkipped: Ride not counted. The measurement restarts at the next full tank.
learn.neverDone: The app won't ask about consumption any more. Turn it back on under “Vehicle”.
learn.outcome.outlier: The value differs a lot from the previous ones and was not saved.
learn.outcome.too-short: Too little distance since the last full tank (at least {km} km), not saved. The measurement restarts.
